muse.name: Muse Gadget OS (WG1200 Dual-Boot)
muse.tagline: Hatch Link + Companion BLE + Weather Station Touch UI
muse.description: Signed ESP32-S3 Muse Gadget firmware for the WeatherXM WG1200. Installs to ota_1 (0x820000) so your original WeatherXM firmware in ota_0 (0x420000) and factory (0x020000) remain untouched for instant 2-second switching.
notes: Signed with WG1200 RSA-3072 Secure Boot V2 key
Dedicated muse_nvs partition at 0xF21000 isolates Muse tokens & Wi-Fi from WeatherXM NVS
Supports Home Link (provision_v2 ECDH P-256 + AES-256-GCM) and Companion BLE GATT
Built-in touchscreen UI with 1-tap "Switch to WeatherXM" button

weatherxm.name: WeatherXM Official Firmware (Latest)
weatherxm.tagline: Official WeatherXM M5 WG1200 Gateway Firmware
weatherxm.description: Official factory-signed WeatherXM WG1200 station gateway firmware (v0.8.39). Installs to ota_0 (0x420000) and boots directly into WeatherXM while preserving Muse in ota_1.
notes: Signed with WG1200 Secure Boot V2 key
Preserves existing device identity, LoRa calibration, and Wi-Fi credentials
Installs to ota_0 (0x420000) without touching Muse in ota_1 (0x820000)
